def harness_time(fn, inputs=(), outputs=(), warmup=10, rep=50, tries=3):
    """Median µs of fn(*inputs, *outputs) with the harness's CUPTI methodology (cold L2, shifted pointers)."""
    from sol_execbench.core.bench.timing import time_runnable
    for attempt in range(tries):
        try:
            ms = time_runnable(fn, list(inputs), list(outputs), "cuda:0", warmup=warmup, rep=rep,
                               return_mode="median", methodology="cupti")
            return ms * 1e3
        except ValueError as e:                          # CUPTI occasionally drops an iteration's records here
            if not any(m in str(e) for m in ("activity sequence", "No timing results")) or attempt == tries - 1:
                raise

def flush_l2():
    """Zero a buffer twice the L2 size, as the harness does before every timed call."""
    from sol_execbench.core.bench.timing import get_l2_cache_size
    torch.empty(2 * get_l2_cache_size("cuda"), dtype=torch.int8, device="cuda").zero_()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()

import subprocess, os, sys, time, re
body = open('/tmp/d6/tc_body.cu').read()
hdr = open('/tmp/d6/tc.cu').read().replace(body, '')
b = body
b = b.replace('for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {', 'for (int pass = 0; pass < ((ABL == 1) ? 1 : 2); pass++) {')
b = b.replace('hv[e] = __float2half_rn(gelu_f(z));', 'hv[e] = __float2half_rn((ABL == 2) ? z : gelu_f(z));')
b = b.replace('if (colb < vcols) *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(dstb', 'if (ABL != 3 && colb < vcols) *reinterpret_cast<uint4*>(dstb')
open('/tmp/d6/tca.cu','w').write(hdr + '#ifndef ABL\n#define ABL 0\n#endif\n' + b)
cmd = 'cd /tmp/d6 && nvcc -O3 --use_fast_math -std=c++17 -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a -DTC_STAMPS=1 -DABL={a} -shared -Xcompiler -fPIC -o tca{a}.so tca.cu -lcuda'
ps = [subprocess.Popen(cmd.format(a=a), shell=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True) for a in (0,1,2,3)]
for pr in ps:
    o,e = pr.communicate(); print('rc', pr.returncode, e[-800:])
r = subprocess.run('cd /tmp/d6 && cuobjdump -res-usage tc0.so | grep -A1 tc_kernel', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True); print(r.stdout[-1500:])
r = subprocess.run('cd /tmp/d6 && cuobjdump -sass tc0.so', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
sass = r.stdout
for fn in re.split(r'Function : ', sass)[1:]:
    name = fn.split('\n')[0]
    if 'tc_kernel' not in name: continue
    ops = re.findall(r'/\*[0-9a-f]{4}\*/\s+(?:@!?U?P\w+\s+)?([A-Z0-9_]+)(\.[A-Z0-9_.]+)?', fn)
    from collections import Counter
    c = Counter(o[0] for o in ops)
    print(name[:40], 'total', sum(c.values()), {k: c[k] for k in ['LDL','STL','MUFU','F2F','F2FP','LDS','STS','STG','FFMA','BAR','LDTM','FSEL','FSETP','ATOMG','REDG','RED'] if k in c})
# precision log of the parent in the background
PREC = r'''
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/d6')
from common import *
lib = ctypes.CDLL(sys.argv[1]); lib.ws_launch.restype = ctypes.c_void_p; lib.ws_workspace_bytes.restype = ctypes.c_longlong
fn = make_fn(lib)
for (B,C,H,W,at) in ROWS:
    torch.manual_seed(200); mx = 0.0; nb = 0
    for rnd in range(10):
        ins = gen(B,C,H,W); out = torch.zeros_like(ins[0]); fn(*ins, out); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        rf = ref(*[t.double() for t in ins])
        e = (out.double() - rf).abs(); mx = max(mx, e.max().item()); nb += (e > at + 1e-5 * rf.abs()).sum().item()
    print(f'{B},{C},{H}x{W} atol {at:.1e} max|err| {mx:.3e} beyond {nb}', flush=True)
'''
open('/tmp/d6/prec.py','w').write(PREC)
STAMPS2 = open('/tmp/d6/stamps.py').read().replace("[(32,768,7,7,0),(16,384,14,14,0),(8,384,14,14,0),(8,768,7,7,0),(16,768,7,7,0),(2,768,7,7,0)]", "[(8,384,14,14,0),(8,768,7,7,0)]")
open('/tmp/d6/stamps2.py','w').write(STAMPS2)
for a in (0,1,2,3):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/tmp/d6/stamps2.py', f'/tmp/d6/tca{a}.so'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=40)
    print('ABL', a); print(r.stdout, r.stderr[-600:])
subprocess.Popen(f'{sys.executable} /tmp/d6/prec.py /tmp/d6/tc0.so > /tmp/d6/prec_parent.log 2>&1', shell=True, start_new_session=True)
